name: Excel Force MSC Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公告新的业务合约、产能扩张或业务退出，主要公告为股本融资计划及公司秘书、注册地址、委员会成员等行政变更。最新季度营收同比增长20.2%，全年营收由27.386百万增至29.246百万MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce new business contracts, capacity expansion, or business exits. Major announcements were an equity fund-raising exercise and administrative changes including company secretary, registered address, and committee members. Latest quarterly revenue grew 20.2% year-on-year, and full-year revenue increased from MYR 27.386 million to MYR 29.246 million.
